csv_scope_of_work: The City of Baytown is seeking to enter into a Professional Services contract with one or more qualified firms registered in the State of Texas. The Scope of Work is comprised of several service discipline categories. A summary description of these categories is provided in Exhibit A. It is the intent of the City to award one or more professional services contracts for the service disciplines as identified below and detailed in Exhibit A. The contract(s) will assist the City of Baytown s Parks and Recreation Department and Engineering Department in its delivery of public services and implementation of capital projects. The Specific Targeted Service Disciplines are as Follows: 1. Land Surveying 2. Park Planning/ Master Planning 3. Space Planning 4. Stormwater Conveyance 5. Landscaping 6. Architectural and Structural 7. Environmental Services 8. Construction Project Management and Construction Inspection
